comment: I had a good experience with Dugas. I came into the class hating math and expecting to get a C at best. I will be coming out with an A or a high B and I thank Dugas for it. Very clear, very helpful, non-presumptious, kinda quirky overall fun professor. Tests aren't bad at all.

I had taken calc before so I did not struggle with this class. Homework counts for more than quizzes-he grades every assignment. THe quizzes are relatively easy depending on how much you prepare. There are 3 tests with an ENORMOUS curve. If you haven't taken calc before I recommend getting a tutor mainly because its not an easy subject.

Calc 1: Hard subject that Dugas did not help me very much with.  I spent most of my time learning from tutors.  Chill attendance policy and about an hour of HW every week. a couple of easy quizzes and 3 impossible exams that you need about a 60% on to get a B with the curve.  Nice, young guy who has some to learn about teaching.  Hard but not impos
